svg.title: Load shedding
svg.desc: Fans send checkout, browsing and analytics requests to a ticket API through a load shedder. When traffic jumps from 3,000 to 25,000 a second the shedder's gauge swings into the red, and it drops browsing and analytics with an instant 503 while every checkout request still reaches the API.
svg.text: Past the limit, browsing and analytics get a fast 503. Checkout gets in.
